tagline: Creating value through active portfolio management and sustainable growth across retail, real estate and technology
hero_kpi_rationale: Net Asset Value (NAV) is the central KPI at Sonae, reflecting value creation through active management of its asset portfolio and external growth operations, the true driver of its group strategy.

kpis.name: Net Asset Value
kpis.explanation: Total value of the group's net assets, based on market valuations.
kpis.description: NAV reached €4,513M in 2023, up 13.6%, driven by the sale of ISRG and the revaluation of MC, Worten and Sierra.
kpis.signal: Major value creation through asset disposals and revaluations.

kpis.name: Consolidated Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated by all group activities.
kpis.description: Consolidated revenue amounted to €8,399M in 2023, driven by MC's growth in the Portuguese grocery retail market.
kpis.signal: Solid growth despite inflation and competition.

kpis.name: Consolidated EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization, a key operational performance indicator.
kpis.description: EBITDA reached €1,000M in 2023, up 7.2%, with 12% growth at constant scope.

kpis.name: Net Income (attributable to equity holders)
kpis.explanation: Net profit attributable to the group's shareholders.
kpis.description: Net income amounted to €357M in 2023, up 6.4% compared to the previous year.
kpis.signal: Profit growth despite higher financial and tax costs.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow (before dividends)
kpis.explanation: Cash generated from operations after investments, before dividend payments.
kpis.description: Free cash flow before dividends was €187M in 2023, similar to the prior year, supported by asset disposals.
kpis.signal: Stable cash generation despite investments in digitalization.

kpis.name: Consolidated Net Debt
kpis.explanation: Net outstanding financial debt at the group level.
kpis.description: Consolidated net debt stood at €526M at end-2023, a historically low level, strengthening the group's financial solidity.
kpis.signal: Record low level of net debt.

kpis.name: Proposed Dividend per Share
kpis.explanation: Amount of dividend proposed to shareholders per share.
kpis.description: The proposed dividend is 5.639 cents per share, up 5%, representing a payout ratio of 25%.
kpis.signal: Dividend growth in line with distribution policy.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €11.36B in the latest year

kpis.name: Net Asset Value - Retail Division
kpis.explanation: Portion of NAV allocated to retail activities (food and electronics).
kpis.description: The Retail division value (MC, Worten) reached €2,418M in 2023, up 19.3%, driven by strong operational performance.

kpis.name: Net Asset Value - Real Estate Division
kpis.explanation: Portion of NAV allocated to the group's real estate assets.
kpis.description: The real estate division value reached €1,057M in 2023, up 20.9%, supported by solid results.
kpis.signal: Strong revaluation of real estate assets.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or related technologies in the provided documents. Sonae's strategy focuses on portfolio management, organic growth and M&A activities in the retail, real estate and financial services sectors.
evidence: No reference to AI or advanced technologies in the CEO letter
Stated strategic priorities are sustainability, digitalization and portfolio management
Recent investments are in healthcare, wellness and consumer credit
